### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/cbd93f9f86b2f7d707a3c4039393254d956eaa80/src/provisioning/runtimeExecutor.ts#L284-L285 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Reserve provisioning metadata paths before staging** Fresh evidence after the trusted-marker fix is that an admitted repository may itself contain `.mcp-provisioning.json` or `.mcp-provisioning.labels.json`. Those regular files pass staging, are excluded from `tree_digest`, and are then overwritten here and during activation; a normal `COPY .` build or project-root bind can therefore execute content different from the admitted archive while all digest checks still pass. Reject these reserved names in the staged source or keep the metadata outside the checkout and build context. ### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/99a4578822970414ea45d344c31a895a9cc4348f/src/provisioning/sourceArchive.ts#L85 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Store retained source archives with owner-only permissions** When the admitted repository is private and S1 has any non-root local account, the normal `022` umask leaves this archive mode at `0644`; the surrounding `data` directory is also ordinarily traversable, and failed or blocked jobs retain their complete repository archives indefinitely. This exposes private source code to unrelated host users even when the checkout is never promoted, unlike the other durable MCP stores that use `0600`; create job directories as `0700` and archive files as `0600`.

### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/Patricked-code/MCP/blob/853e10ee6008c53869e40444ad4472ef1f1f1665/src/provisioning/sourceArchive.ts#L84-L85 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Keep downloaded private archives owner-only** Every fetched repository tarball is created with mode `0644`, and its recursively created job directory normally inherits a world-traversable mode from the process umask. On the bind-mounted host data directory, any local account or colocated process with filesystem access can therefore read the complete source of a private repository, while successful and failed job archives are retained indefinitely. Create provisioning directories as `0700` and archives as `0600` before writing private source material.
